483-1981-2415-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
483-1981-2415-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2060-4213-4687.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
2060-4213-4687.description:
Activate Hankyu by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

2092-4687-6006.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2092-4687-6006.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
2092-4687-6006.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1385-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-3967-6559.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

1981-2415-7818-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-7818-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1170-1283-1986-7530.description:
Cast the copy of Bind to Life from exile by paying five mana and unpreparing Vastlands Scavenger.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Vastlands Scavenger, which enters prepared.
Resolve the copy of Bind to Life, milling seven cards and optionally putting a creature card from among them onto the battlefield.
Activate Titans' Nest five times by exiling five cards from your graveyard, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that can be cast as though it were any color but only on colored spells without X in their cost.
Repeat.

654-1409-7898.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts.
654-1409-7898.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking Smaug.
When Smaug enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Smaug.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating a number of tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

301-5663-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

1379-2388-6587-7012.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
1379-2388-6587-7012.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

997-1445-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1394-2060-5147-6627-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by The Earth Crystal.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by The Earth Crystal.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1350-4010-6723-7060.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {4}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-6723-7060.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1978-2416-4131.description:
Animate Basalt Monolith using Rise and Shine.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

4375-5256-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

862-5220-5683-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

3388-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1.
Repeat.

997-2523-5558.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Enraged Huorn.
When Enraged Huorn dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Enraged Huorn that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Enraged Huorn token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Enraged Huorn token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

440-1339-5070-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-5070-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

511-817-3921-4050-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
511-817-3921-4050-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1061-2232-5778.manaNeeded: {3}{U} available the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{U} each following turn
1061-2232-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-2232-5778.description:
Cast TImestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}, plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
If you control ten or more permanents and don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Resolve the Timestream Navigator trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
If you control ten or more permanents and don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
When the Timestream Navigator token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator from the battlefield to your hand.
During your next turn, repeat steps 1 through 7 one additional time.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 8.

1778-2034-3856-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {C}{C}.
When Memnite dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ruxa, adding {C}{C}.
When Ruxa dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ruxa from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ruxa enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning Memnite to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

225-539-2443-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller is untapped.
You have a basic land in library.
225-539-2443-5077.description:
Play Evolving Wilds.
Evolving Wilds enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Activate Evolving Wilds by tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic land and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The basic land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Evolving Wilds from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

647-803-3742-4251-4344.notablePrerequisites:
"Samurai" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
647-803-3742-4251-4344.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
The token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, exiling Godo until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
At the end of your combat phase, the token Lumbering Battlement triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3681-3946-5064.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Skirk Fire Marshal.
You control at least five untapped Goblins.
3681-3946-5064.description:
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five untapped Goblins, giving each creature ten -1/-1 counters and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten poison counters.

2019-2773-2906-4050.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Rakdos.
2019-2773-2906-4050.description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Warstorm Surges triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to command zone.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

1460-4954.notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine artifacts.
1460-4954.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan's second ability by tapping it, adding at least nine {U}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {8}, causing Vault of Catlacan to become a 8/8 Elemental with haste, and untapping Vault of Catlacan.
Repeat.

1339-1940-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

92-1545-1738.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
92-1545-1738.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life when you gain life this turn.
Cast Serra Avatar by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Serra Avatar enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1061-3117-4844.notablePrerequisites:
Timesteam Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
1061-3117-4844.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cellar Door by paying {3} and tapping it, causing you to put Timestream Navigator from the bottom of your library into your graveyard and create a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Grolnok triggers, exiling Timestream Navigator with a croak counter on it.
Cast Timestream Navigator from exile by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

2734-4131-4893.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2734-4131-4893.description:
Cast Cyberdrive Awakener by paying {5}{U}.
Cyberdrive Awakener enters the battlefield, causing all noncreature artifacts you control to become 4/4 artifact creatures until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
